settings.title: Pack the pieces you will actually use.
settings.text: Travel setups should stay tight: towel, marker, brush, and a few small accessories that reset fast.

settings.title: Keep the accent easy to spot.
settings.text: A consistent accent makes it easier to recognize your gear when bags and carts get mixed.

settings.title: Good golf-trip gifts should be useful.
settings.text: Small matched accessories work well for buddy trips, member-guests, and destination rounds.

settings.title: Pack visible essentials
settings.text: Towel, brush, marker, and one accent color are enough for most trips.

settings.title: Avoid fragile extras
settings.text: Travel favors simple gear that can be cleaned, packed, and reset quickly.

settings.title: Reset after the round
settings.text: Keep the same routine after each day so the next tee time starts clean.

settings.heading: Build a bag that travels clean.
settings.subheading: A simple setup path for golf trips, destination rounds, and keeping the useful pieces easy to find.
